Preserve all independently justified valid answers.

A card can quote a sentence exactly yet represent a false claim or the wrong argument. Separate direct evidence for the asked relation from stories about associated entities. Do not infer a document is fake solely from style; challenge substantive inconsistencies and role mismatches. Keep canonical answers justified by this reconstruction, even if an earlier tentative prior is empty. Do not return duplicate aliases or a union of mutually exclusive values.
